anomalies.impact: This permanently shorts M5Stack bus pins 19 and 21 together, and pins 20 and 22 together. If either pin is driven by the M5Stack or a stacked module, the two outputs contend, potentially causing malfunction or damage. It also defeats the intended per-core PWM pin selection and, because the serial-mode jumpers are also populated, ties the shared serial servo bus to these PWM GPIO nets through the 1 kΩ series resistors.
